authoring_provenance.note: Codex assisted with the project-authored scenario surfaces. The interface did not expose the exact underlying model identifier. Version 1.1.0 made held-constant facts and the nuisance bundle more explicit. Version 1.2.0 added 24 provisional test scenarios so each domain-by-attribute cell has six distinct families and a 16-turn run needs no reuse. Version 1.3.0 applies an outcome-blind critical revision: travel prompts now hold realistic service, access, timing, and reliability facts; ambiguous premium and planning bundles are defined; writing contexts with normative style cues or target cross-loading are revised; and spelling tasks declare no required house style. No evaluated-model or experiment outcomes were consulted. These Codex-assisted checks do not count as the required independent human reviews, and all records remain provisional. Version 1.4.0 removes the non-operational difficulty label, prospectively counterbalances both restricted-peer nuisance dimensions and directions, and removes identified semantic cross-loads such as route-planning aids, protection cues, and contradictory timing descriptions without using evaluated-model outcomes. Version 1.5.0 adds an explicit target half-span and prospectively calibrates the six held-out scenarios in each domain-by-attribute cell from subtle to pronounced contrasts; train and development scenarios retain the canonical 0.50 span. This calibration was defined without consulting evaluated-model outcomes, and all records remain provisional.
